suggested_change: Criterion 1: Specify whether score-evidence alignment applies directionally (e.g., 'scores below 5/10 do not require direct quotes; scores above 5/10 do'). Criterion 2: Require explicit documentation of score changes with supporting evidence. Criterion 4: Clarify whether '[Contact TBD]' requires committed action verb or if conditional phrasing ('ask at X') satisfies the requirement. Criterion 5: Define 'urgency' operationally—either require prospect statement or adjust scoring scale to reflect absence of urgency as a lower band.
